text:
mira: quick follow-up from the safetensors format RFC. Hit a production case where an older quant shard slipped through and later produced NaNs in GEMM. Thinking: fast header-probe on open + optional background full-verify. sound reasonable?

jon: what did the failure look like?

mira: gist from node:
```
[2026-04-02T15:02:11Z] load_shard ckpt-v7-part2.safetensors: index ok, header legacy
[2026-04-02T15:02:11Z] WARN loader: dtype mismatch expected=float16 found=quant8
RuntimeError: GEMM produced NaN
```

sasha: choices: eager verify on open (extra small read) or lazy verify at first exec (delayed failing). Probe-on-open improves user predictability.

dmitri: Hosted/Dedicated: probe-on-open default. Private: config flag to opt-out.

mira: API plan: WeightSource.open() unchanged return shape but add optional metadata keys (strings): `serializer_id` and `probe_status` with values: "unknown"|"header_ok"|"header_mismatch"|"deep_ok"|"deep_corrupt". Backwards compatible.

 sasha: header schema proposal: magic="RSFT1", serializer_id (e.g. "redwood.quant_v3"), schema_version, epoch, mini_sig (fast blake2b-64), optional `full_checksum_url`. mini_sig fast, full checksum authoritative.

ops: ops concern: blocking on open could spike errors during rollout. Need toggle + canary. Add metrics: `weights.header_mismatch.count`, `weights.deep_corrupt.count`, `weights.open.latency`.

mira: rollout sketch:
- canary: sample probe on 5% traffic, emit metrics
- enable header probe for new uploads; legacy checkpoints accepted but marked `legacy` and queued for background verify on access
- after N days, optionally block legacy acceptance behind tenant-level policy

dmitri: runtime behavior: on header_mismatch try fallback variant (float fallback), emit `weights.fallback.attempt` metric; if fallback fails surface error. Background verifier updates `probe_status` via metadata API.

ci-bot: will add `serializer-roundtrip` CI job: write shard -> header probe -> compute full checksum -> verify deep_ok. Hook on serializer repo PRs.

jon: small note: keep header probe cheap: parse first N bytes only. Also add unit test that simulates old header and ensures probe rejects.

sasha: Console: per-checkpoint integrity badge (green/amber/red). For live flips to red, auto-create support ticket for Dedicated/Private.

mira: i'll file a tiny RFC patch with header schema, metadata keys, verifier behaviour, runtime fallback + metrics, rollout toggles. Owners: mira (author), jon (loader), sasha (console), ops (rollout). Will land doc today and open PR next week. tagging @team-eng-ml :eyes:
